sloka: अवप्लुत्य ततः शीघ्रं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्।अब्रवीत् कुपितः कुम्भं भग्नशृङ्गमिव द्विपम् ।। ६.७६.७१ ।।
transliteration: avaplutya tataḥ śīghraṁ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram।abravīt kupitaḥ kumbhaṁ bhagnaśṛṅgamiva dvipam ।। 6.76.71 ।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva leapt into the chariot, which was a difficult deed to perform, saw Kumbha who was like an elephant and whose tusks were broken and spoke.
